src: U.S. Census Bureau cartographic boundary files, 2025 vintage (GENZ2025; state legislative districts for the 2024 legislative session year), 1:500,000; State Senate and State House districts from the Census Bureau 2026 TIGER/Line state legislative districts (the plan for the 2026 election cycle), clipped to the same shoreline
note: Mississippi’s State Senate and State House were redrawn after the 2024 session. The new districts are drawn here, each colored by who held that district number before the election, who may have been elected from the earlier lines.
